official_web_findings.finding: Office for National Statistics publisher; last updated 10 June 2026; current and terminated postcodes related to geographies; issued quarterly.
ONSPD uses point-in-polygon and assigns boundary-straddling postcodes using the mean grid reference; products released quarterly in February, May, August and November.
Last updated 17 June 2026; digital vector centroids for live UK postcodes as at May 2026; geography only.
NSUL/ONSUD provide UPRN/address geography products; geography linkage does not supply broadband service/currentness.
UPRN-level premise current/future/intervention candidate layer remains separate from ONS geography.

acceptance: postcode/centroid/UPRN geography alone cannot promote a broadband product row
